description: This is a C# source file implementing a command-line tool named CoverageSummary. It restores tools, locates coverage reports (Cobertura XMLs), generates HTML and Markdown summaries using ReportGenerator, and includes fallback parsing of coverage reports.

classes.name: Program
classes.description: Main class containing the command-line utility implementation.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: Main entry point setting up command-line options and executing coverage report generation.

methods.name: EnsureDir
methods.description: Creates directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: EscapeForReportGenerator
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes for compatibility with ReportGenerator.

methods.name: GlobFiles
methods.description: Implements glob pattern matching, specifically handling '**' for recursive search.

methods.name: ParseReportGeneratorSummary
methods.description: Parses JSON or XML reports generated by ReportGenerator to extract coverage summaries.

methods.name: ParseCoberturaFallback
methods.description: Fallback method that parses Cobertura XML files directly if JSON/XML summaries are unavailable.

methods.name: DeriveProjectNameFromCoberturaPath
methods.description: Derives project name from the file path of Cobertura coverage files.

methods.name: WeightedBranch
methods.description: Calculates weighted branch coverage percentage across projects.

methods.name: TryParseDouble
methods.description: Safely parses string to double, returning 0 on failure.

methods.name: Round2
methods.description: Rounds a double to two decimal places.

methods.name: RunCmd
methods.description: Executes a command-line process asynchronously, capturing output and errors.

methods.name: WriteMarkdown
methods.description: Generates a Markdown file with coverage summary details.

methods.name: WriteRedirect
methods.description: Creates an HTML redirect page to coverage report.
